plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp boxing strength-and-power build with one focused full-body session each week. Week 1 establishes baseline performance with a squat assessment so later loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main training work begins in Week 2. With only one S&C day per week and minimal home equipment, the plan keeps the highest-value work in place: explosive jumps and throws first, then main strength, then practical accessories and short conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body force, upper-body pushing and pulling strength, and simple explosive output with low-complexity exercises.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power crisp while managing fatigue around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster, sharper power and speed expression while holding onto the strength built earlier.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high and fast as you can. Stick each landing quietly and rest fully between sets.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if ceiling space or landing control makes the countermovement jump awkward.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low stable box and focus on crisp takeoff and controlled landing.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Brace hard, keep depth consistent, and stop if form breaks. This session sets your baseline for future progression.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your baseline strength.

performanceTarget.prompt: Record your best clean top set of 3-5 reps.
